Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Installed the AI Observability integration and its five dashboards
- Configured OTEL environment variables for Grafana Cloud
- Instrumented a Python application with the OpenLIT SDK
- Verified that telemetry data is arriving in your dashboards

---
